# algizian_tenants (Data Source)

The tenants of an organization, optionally only those that carry all the given tags.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# every production tenant of the organization of the token
data "algizian_tenants" "prod" {
  tags = { env = "prod" }
}

output "prod_issuers" {
  value = [for t in data.algizian_tenants.prod.tenants : coalesce(t.custom_domain_issuer, t.issuer)]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org` (String) Organization slug; defaults to the provider `org`, else the organization of the token.
- `tags` (Map of String) Keep only tenants that have all of these tags (exact values).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tenants` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenants))
